lines: d16: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Carmine Winkler is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d16: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d16: 🕯️ Carmine Winkler is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d16: What Carmine kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d16: "Carmine's gone." Francois looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Carmine." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d16: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Elijah blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d16: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
d16: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d16: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d16: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d16: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d16: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d16: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Carmine Winkler, 16 days. The mantle passes to Elijah Novak.
d16: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Elijah Novak, 52 — a Social worker. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location.
d16: The village's quarrel was with Carmine — and Carmine is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d16: At the grave, Francois, Leo speak for Elijah — "Carmine trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d16: The fire knew Elijah before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
